nodes.label: PendingSpellingStatusStore (PendingSpellingStatus.xml)
nodes.rationale: No plugin API for spelling status and Paratext does not watch the file, so fixes are recorded under local/ (excluded from Send/Receive) and merged after Paratext exits.

nodes.label: QueryGoodSpelling (public, non-modal capable)
nodes.rationale: Approach A chosen: users want code-point panes (e.g. Devanagari ZWJ differences) and every CSC client benefits from Similar words, so one dialog lives in core and the plugin hosts it non-modally.

nodes.label: EncConverters core NuGet upgrade procedure
nodes.rationale: Manual find/replace preferred over Manage NuGet Packages because the latter doesn't update x86 vs x64 builds properly or use EcLibFilesPath.

nodes.label: Three-layer architecture (clients / core / engines)
nodes.rationale: Core abstraction layer lets client apps access many transduction engines without implementing each interface separately.

nodes.label: Verse-by-verse checking flow
nodes.rationale: Fixes are collected per verse and written once per verse via RequestWriteLock/PutUSFMTokens; sync group follows the verse being checked. End-of-chapter continue prompts later removed per user request.

nodes.label: UsfmChapterTokens
nodes.rationale: Extracted from BackTranslationHelperForm for sharing; GroupByVerse groups by computed key string rather than IVerseRef to avoid depending on IVerseRef equality (TestVerseReference.Equals throws).

nodes.label: UnitTest_PtxSpellFixer
nodes.rationale: Uses extern alias SpellFixer because the new assembly also contains linked public types in the same namespace as the sister assembly.

nodes.label: SpellFixerSession
nodes.rationale: Skip / Replace Once / Replace Every / Replace All / Cancel state machine; empty correction is a valid replacement, only null cancels; Replace Every reuses the user's edited spelling.

nodes.label: SpellFixerTokenProcessor
nodes.rationale: Pure, UI-independent logic so it can be unit tested: splits text into alternating word/separator runs that rebuild exactly, fixes publishable vernacular text tokens, splices a verse back into the chapter.

nodes.label: SpellingStatusUpdater.exe
nodes.rationale: Launched on host.ShuttingDown with --wait-pid; waits up to 30 min for Paratext to exit, backs up SpellingStatus.xml under local, merges pending fixes.

nodes.label: ParatextBackTranslationHelperPlugin Merge Module
nodes.rationale: Spell Fixer added to existing merge module; Feature Id kept so upgrades still work, title changed to SIL Converters Plugins for Paratext.

nodes.label: MapPtxProjectToSpellFixerConverter setting
nodes.rationale: Remembers last-chosen SpellFixer converter per Paratext project; converter name prefix records CSC vs legacy kind, so no encoding-converters-core change needed.

nodes.label: Scratch PowerShell reflection harness
nodes.rationale: Neither repo has a test project for this code, so verification is builds plus scratch PowerShell harness driving internals via reflection.

nodes.label: CSC .cct custom changes section preservation
nodes.rationale: Bug fix: hand-typed rules between start/end custom changes markers were lost on save; the existing .cct is now source of truth, CustomCcCode in .csf only a fallback.

nodes.label: SpellFixerForm.ApplyFix
nodes.rationale: If the user edited the bad form, rule is saved but Paratext text is not changed since the selection no longer matches.

nodes.label: FixSpellingForm (non-modal dialog)
nodes.rationale: Non-modal so the user can still search/copy in Paratext while it is up; only this dialog is non-modal, the check-run query stays modal.

nodes.label: ParatextProjectFolder
nodes.rationale: Plugin API doesn't expose the project folder; derived from registry Settings_Directory and verified against Settings.xml Guid.

nodes.label: PluginFindReplaceHelper
nodes.rationale: Subclass exposes FindReplaceHelper's protected m_cscProject/m_aSpellFixerLegacy without changing encoding-converters-core, keeping one in-memory project copy.

nodes.label: SpellingStatusRecorder
nodes.rationale: No plugin API to change spelling status, so fixes are recorded to a pending file for later merge; warnings shown once per project per session.

nodes.label: SpellingStatusUpdater.exe
nodes.rationale: Runs after Paratext exits (--wait-pid, up to 30 min) because Paratext keeps its own in-memory copy of SpellingStatus.

nodes.rationale: Right-hand word in a multi-row bundle is the most frequent spelling, hence more likely the correct form of the left-hand variants.

nodes.label: Bad spelling must always be bad (rule)

nodes.rationale: Correction always replaces the bad form with the good form in documents, so it must not be used to separate two distinct valid words.

nodes.label: SpellFixerForm.WriteVerse
nodes.rationale: Re-reads the chapter after RequestWriteLock (which may save pending user edits) and aborts if the verse text changed, then does one PutUSFMTokens per verse.

nodes.label: SpellFixerTokenProcessor.FixWords
nodes.rationale: Whole whitespace-delimited run (including attached punctuation) goes to the converter unchanged; the CC table's word-boundary rules decide punctuation handling.

nodes.label: SpellFixerTokenProcessor.VerseText
nodes.rationale: Used to detect that a verse changed in Paratext between being read and written, so stale tokens never overwrite edits.

nodes.label: Combined verse start handling
nodes.rationale: When Paratext points at a single verse inside a combined verse (MAT 5:4 in \v 3-4), the run starts at the combined 40_005_003-004 group.

nodes.label: One PutUSFMTokens write per verse with fixes
nodes.norm_label: one putusfmtokens write per verse with fixes

nodes.label: Stale verse overwrite guard
nodes.rationale: If the verse changes in Paratext between read and write (e.g. unsaved edits saved during RequestWriteLock), the run stops with a message instead of overwriting.

nodes.label: PluginAssemblyResolver
nodes.rationale: AssemblyResolve hook moved out of the plugin class so both plugins can share it; logs via a delegate and registers only once.

nodes.label: SpellFixerForm (non-modal main window)
nodes.rationale: Paratext/WinForms glue; remembers the chosen SpellFixer project per Paratext project; ignores VerseRefChanged while checking since it drives the sync group itself.

nodes.label: SpellFixerPlugin (IParatextStandalonePlugin)
nodes.rationale: Entry point on Tools menu; one window at a time, reused if for the same project.

nodes.label: SpellFixerProject
nodes.rationale: Wraps FindReplaceHelper plus a DirectableEncConverter; reloads the converter after rule edits so new rules apply to the next word checked.

nodes.label: SpellFixerQueryFormBase
nodes.rationale: Adapted copy of Office BaseConverterForm: FontConverter replaced by DirectableEncConverter + Font, ForwardString renamed CorrectedSpelling, Show takes an owner.

nodes.label: Encoding-Converters-Core 1.0.2
nodes.rationale: Global constraint: do not change encoding-converters-core.
